items.title: A new Start screen
items.text: Every unit now opens with three choices: Test tomorrow? (a guided session for tonight, in short rounds), I have a few days (a study plan), or Let me pick. The tabs are grouped into Study, Test yourself and Notes.

items.title: Midterm review
items.text: Open it from the course page: mixed questions from every unit, a little each day, with more from your weak units, plus a 40-question mock midterm. Midterms are the week of Dec 14.

items.title: Focus timer
items.text: Work, then a short break, on repeat (25 + 5, 50 + 10, or your own). It pauses if you switch tabs. Find it on Start.

items.title: Pick your exact time and days
items.text: Tonight's session, the Study plan and Midterm review take any time from 15 minutes to 5 hours, and the Study plan asks how many days to spread it over.

items.title: Less clutter
items.text: Flashcard and Practice Test settings moved under Options, Study guide decks fold up, and the course page shows how far along you are.

items.title: One Gemini key for every kit
items.text: Add a free Gemini key once in Settings and it grades written answers in every kit. If the key stops working, a pop-up lets you update it.

items.title: Smaller decks
items.text: Research Methods, Sleep & Drugs, and Treatment are split into smaller decks. Your progress carried over.

items.title: Formula boxes and self-checking answers
items.text: Typed formulas show subscripts and charges as you type (H2O becomes H₂O), with an optional boxes mode. Many short answers in Chapters 3 and 4 now check themselves.

items.title: Short answers check themselves
items.text: Each SAQ part shows which key ideas your answer has. You can still mark it yourself, or grade it with Gemini.
